text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use of NLP is text understanding, which allows machines to read and find meaning in written words. For example, translation apps use NLP to change text from one language into another, like English to Spanish. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover if customers feel happy or angry about a product. Chatbots also depend on NLP because they need to understand questions and answer them naturally. In short, NLP makes it possible for computers and people to communicate more easily in everyday life.
